```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(base64enc)
library(here)
library(AirMonitor)
library(MazamaCoreUtils)
library(lutz)
library(png)
library(rvest)
library(RCurl)
library(rjson)
library(curl)

source(here::here("R", "helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "multi_burn_helpers.R"))

make_data_uri <- function(path, mime = "image/png") {
  if (file.exists(path)) base64enc::dataURI(file = path, mime = mime) else path
}

download_data_uri <- function(url, mime = "image/png") {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  tryCatch({
    curl::curl_download(url, destfile = tmp, quiet = TRUE)
    base64enc::dataURI(file = tmp, mime = mime)
  }, error = function(e) url)
}

fire_icon_uri <- make_data_uri(here::here("assets", "red-fire-flame.png"))
perm_mon_icon_uri <- download_data_uri("https://github.com/jeremyash/icons/blob/main/perm_mon.png?raw=true")
temp_mon_icon_uri <- download_data_uri("https://github.com/jeremyash/icons/blob/main/temp_mon.png?raw=true")
report_icon_uri <- make_data_uri(here::here("www", "favicon_512x512_rounded.png"))
```

```{r prepare_runs, include=FALSE}
runs_input <- params$RUNS |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    run_id = trimws(as.character(run_id)),
    burn_name = trimws(as.character(burn_name %||% ""))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(run_id), nzchar(run_id)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

if (nrow(runs_input) < 1) stop("At least one BlueSky run ID is required.")

run_info <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  runs_input$run_id,
  runs_input$burn_name,
  read_bluesky_run_info
)

report_tz <- tryCatch(
  lutz::tz_lookup_coords(
    lat = mean(run_info$lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    lon = mean(run_info$lon, na.rm = TRUE),
    method = "fast"
  ),
  error = function(e) run_info$tz[1]
)

if (
  is.na(report_tz) ||
  !nzchar(report_tz)
) {
  report_tz <- run_info$tz[1]
}

generated_at <- lubridate::with_tz(Sys.time(), report_tz)
generated_at_sen <- paste0(
  "Issued at ",
  format(generated_at, "%H:%M %B %d, %Y"),
  " ",
  format(generated_at, "%Z")
)

burn_points <- run_info |>
  select(run_id, burn_name, label, lat, lon, acres)

map_bounds <- list(
  xmin = min(run_info$xmin, na.rm = TRUE),
  ymin = min(run_info$ymin, na.rm = TRUE),
  xmax = max(run_info$xmax, na.rm = TRUE),
  ymax = max(run_info$ymax, na.rm = TRUE)
)

outlook_path <- file.path(tempdir(), paste0("multi_burn_", as.integer(Sys.time())))
dir.create(outlook_path, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

template_raster <- make_template_raster(run_info)
template_bounds <- list(
  xmin = terra::xmin(template_raster),
  ymin = terra::ymin(template_raster),
  xmax = terra::xmax(template_raster),
  ymax = terra::ymax(template_raster)
)
```

```{r monitors, include=FALSE}
monitor_center <- tibble(
  longitude = mean(run_info$lon, na.rm = TRUE),
  latitude = mean(run_info$lat, na.rm = TRUE)
)

burn_spread_m <- tryCatch({
  pts <- sf::st_as_sf(run_info, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
  pts_m <- sf::st_transform(pts, 5070)
  as.numeric(max(sf::st_distance(pts_m)))
}, error = function(e) 0)

monitor_radius <- max(300000, burn_spread_m + 100000, na.rm = TRUE)
startdate <- as.Date(params$BURN_DATE) - 3
enddate <- as.Date(params$BURN_DATE) - 1

rec_daily_df <- tryCatch({
  near_mon <- AirMonitor::monitor_loadLatest() |>
    AirMonitor::monitor_filterDistance(
      longitude = monitor_center$longitude,
      latitude = monitor_center$latitude,
      radius = monitor_radius,
      addToMeta = TRUE
    ) |>
    AirMonitor::monitor_arrange(distanceFromTarget) |>
    AirMonitor::monitor_slice_head(40)

  near_mon$data |>
    mutate(datetime = ymd(as_date(datetime))) |>
    filter(datetime >= startdate & datetime <= enddate) |>
    group_by(datetime) |>
    summarise_all(.funs = mean, na.rm = TRUE) |>
    ungroup() |>
    tidyr::gather(deviceDeploymentID, pm_val, -datetime) |>
    mutate(
      aqi_col = AirMonitor::aqiColors(pm_val, pollutant = "PM2.5", palette = "EPA"),
      aqi_cat = cut(pm_val, breaks = AirMonitor::US_AQI$breaks_AQI, labels = AirMonitor::US_AQI$names_eng)
    ) |>
    left_join(near_mon$meta, by = "deviceDeploymentID") |>
    mutate(
      siteName = stringr::str_to_title(locationName),
      mon_v5_url = paste0(
        '<a href="https://tools.airfire.org/monitoring/v5/?centerlat=',
        latitude,
        '&centerlon=',
        longitude,
        '&zoom=9&monitors=',
        deviceDeploymentID,
        '" target="_blank">',
        siteName,
        '</a>'
      )
    ) |>
    filter(datetime == max(datetime))
}, error = function(e) NULL)

perm_mon_df <- if (!is.null(rec_daily_df)) dplyr::filter(rec_daily_df, deploymentType == "Permanent") else NULL
temp_mon_df <- if (!is.null(rec_daily_df)) dplyr::filter(rec_daily_df, deploymentType == "Temporary") else NULL
```

```{r combine_daily, include=FALSE}
daily_dir <- file.path(outlook_path, "daily")

dir.create(
  daily_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)


# Find the available daily-average PNG for each run.

daily_index <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(run_info)),
  function(i) {

    idx <- get_daily_pm25_png_index(
      run_info[i, ]
    )

    if (nrow(idx) == 0) {
      stop(
        "No daily-average PM2.5 PNG found for BlueSky run ID: ",
        run_info$run_id[i]
      )
    }


    # There should normally be one relevant rendered
    # daily-average PNG for the run.

    idx |>
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        run_i = i
      )
  }
)


daily_files <- purrr::map_chr(
  seq_len(nrow(daily_index)),
  function(i) {

    dest <- file.path(
      daily_dir,
      paste0(
        daily_index$run_id[i],
        "_daily.png"
      )
    )


    download_file_safe(
      daily_index$url[i],
      dest
    )
  }
)


daily_bounds <- purrr::map(
  daily_index$run_i,
  function(i) {

    list(
      xmin = run_info$xmin[i],
      ymin = run_info$ymin[i],
      xmax = run_info$xmax[i],
      ymax = run_info$ymax[i]
    )
  }
)


daily_combined <- combine_pm25_pngs(
  png_files = daily_files,
  bounds_list = daily_bounds,
  template_raster = template_raster
)


daily_png <- file.path(
  outlook_path,
  "combined_daily_exposure_index.png"
)


write_exposure_index_raster_png(
  daily_combined,
  daily_png,
  breaks = daily_exposure_breaks
)


daily_png_uri <- base64enc::dataURI(
  file = daily_png,
  mime = "image/png"
)
```

```{r combine_hourly, include=FALSE}
hourly_dir <- file.path(
  outlook_path,
  "hourly"
)

dir.create(
  hourly_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)


# Build one UTC-indexed table containing the
# hourly images available for every run.

hourly_index <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(run_info)),
  function(i) {

    idx <- get_hourly_pm25_png_index(
      run_info[i, ]
    )

    if (nrow(idx) == 0) {
      return(
        tibble::tibble()
      )
    }


    idx |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        run_i = i
      )
  }
)


if (nrow(hourly_index) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No hourly PM2.5 PNGs were found for the supplied BlueSky runs."
  )
}


# Use every modeled absolute time represented
# by at least one run.

common_times <- sort(
  unique(
    hourly_index$datetime_utc
  )
)


# Keep a reasonable upper limit for the
# self-contained HTML report.

if (length(common_times) > 72) {
  common_times <- common_times[
    seq_len(72)
  ]
}


hourly_outputs <- purrr::map_chr(
  seq_along(common_times),
  function(j) {

    current_time <- common_times[j]


    # Only runs that have output at this exact
    # UTC time contribute to this frame.

    rows <- hourly_index |>
      dplyr::filter(
        datetime_utc == current_time
      )


    downloaded_files <- purrr::map_chr(
      seq_len(nrow(rows)),
      function(k) {

        dest <- file.path(
          hourly_dir,
          paste0(
            rows$run_id[k],
            "_",
            format(
              current_time,
              "%Y%m%d%H%M",
              tz = "UTC"
            ),
            ".png"
          )
        )


        download_file_safe(
          rows$url[k],
          dest
        )
      }
    )


    frame_bounds <- purrr::map(
      rows$run_i,
      function(i) {

        list(
          xmin = run_info$xmin[i],
          ymin = run_info$ymin[i],
          xmax = run_info$xmax[i],
          ymax = run_info$ymax[i]
        )
      }
    )


    combined_raster <- combine_pm25_pngs(
      png_files = downloaded_files,
      bounds_list = frame_bounds,
      template_raster = template_raster
    )


    out_png <- file.path(
      hourly_dir,
      paste0(
        "combined_hourly_",
        format(
          current_time,
          "%Y%m%d%H%M",
          tz = "UTC"
        ),
        ".png"
      )
    )


    write_exposure_index_raster_png(
      combined_raster,
      out_png,
      breaks = hourly_exposure_breaks
    )


    out_png
  }
)


hourly_png_data <- purrr::map_chr(
  hourly_outputs,
  function(path) {

    base64enc::dataURI(
      file = path,
      mime = "image/png"
    )
  }
)


# UTC is used internally for matching the runs,
# but the report displays one local timeline.

hourly_labels <- format(
  lubridate::with_tz(
    common_times,
    report_tz
  ),
  "%H:%M %b %d, %Y"
)
```

```{r leaflet_helpers, include=FALSE}
add_burn_and_monitor_layers <- function(map) {
  map <- map |>
    addMarkers(
      data = burn_points,
      lng = ~lon,
      lat = ~lat,
      icon = list(
        iconUrl = fire_icon_uri,
        iconWidth = 24,
        iconHeight = 24,
        iconAnchorX = 12,
        iconAnchorY = 12
      ),
      options = markerOptions(
        pane = "marker_map"
      ),
      label = ~label,
      popup = ~paste0("<b>", label, "</b><br/>Acres: ", round(acres, 1)),
      group = "Burn units"
    )

  if (!is.null(temp_mon_df) && nrow(temp_mon_df) > 0) {
    map <- map |>
      addMarkers(
        data = temp_mon_df,
        lng = ~longitude,
        lat = ~latitude,
        icon = list(iconUrl = temp_mon_icon_uri, iconSize = c(15, 15)),
        popup = ~mon_v5_url,
        label = ~paste0(siteName, ": ", round(pm_val, 1), " µg/m³"),
        group = "Temporary monitors"
      )
  }

  if (!is.null(perm_mon_df) && nrow(perm_mon_df) > 0) {
    map <- map |>
      addCircleMarkers(
        data = perm_mon_df,
        lng = ~longitude,
        lat = ~latitude,
        fillColor = ~aqi_col,
        fillOpacity = 1,
        stroke = TRUE,
        color = "black",
        popup = ~mon_v5_url,
        label = ~paste0(siteName, ": ", round(pm_val, 1), " µg/m³"),
        radius = 8,
        weight = 1,
        group = "Permanent monitors"
      )
  }

  map
}

fit_to_runs <- function(map) {
  pad <- 0.5
  map |>
    fitBounds(
      lng1 = min(run_info$lon, na.rm = TRUE) - pad,
      lat1 = min(run_info$lat, na.rm = TRUE) - pad,
      lng2 = max(run_info$lon, na.rm = TRUE) + pad,
      lat2 = max(run_info$lat, na.rm = TRUE) + pad
    )
}
```

```{r make_maps, include=FALSE}
daily_leaflet <- leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Voyager, group = "Street") |>
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery", group = "Terrain") |>
  addMapPane("smoke_map", zIndex = 460) |>
  addMapPane("marker_map", zIndex = 700) |>
  addLegend(
    colors = exposure_cols,
    labels = exposure_labels,
    title = htmltools::HTML("Combined Smoke Exposure"),
    opacity = 1
  ) |>
  add_burn_and_monitor_layers() |>
  fit_to_runs() |>
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomright") |>
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c("Burn units", "Permanent monitors", "Temporary monitors"),
    baseGroups = c("Street", "Terrain"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender(
    "
    function(el, x, data) {
      var map = this;
      var bounds = [[data.ymin, data.xmin], [data.ymax, data.xmax]];
      L.imageOverlay(data.url, bounds, {
        opacity: 1,
        pane: 'smoke_map',
        className: 'png-raster-overlay'
      }).addTo(map);
    }
    ",
    data = list(
      url = daily_png_uri,
      xmin = template_bounds$xmin,
      ymin = template_bounds$ymin,
      xmax = template_bounds$xmax,
      ymax = template_bounds$ymax
    )
  )

hourly_leaflet <- leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Voyager, group = "Street") |>
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery", group = "Terrain") |>
  addMapPane(
    "smoke_map",
    zIndex = 460
  ) |>
  addMapPane(
    "marker_map",
    zIndex = 700
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    colors = exposure_cols,
    labels = exposure_labels,
    title = htmltools::HTML("Combined Smoke Exposure"),
    opacity = 1
  ) |>
  add_burn_and_monitor_layers() |>
  fit_to_runs() |>
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomright") |>
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c("Burn units", "Permanent monitors", "Temporary monitors"),
    baseGroups = c("Street", "Terrain"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender(
    "
    function(el, x, data) {
      var map = this;
      var bounds = [[data.ymin, data.xmin], [data.ymax, data.xmax]];
      var overlays = data.urls.map(function(url) {
        return L.imageOverlay(url, bounds, {
          opacity: 1,
          pane: 'smoke_map',
          className: 'png-raster-overlay'
        });
      });

      var currentIndex = 0;
      overlays[currentIndex].addTo(map);

      var sliderControl = L.control({position: 'bottomleft'});
      sliderControl.onAdd = function(map) {
        var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'hourly-slider-control leaflet-bar');
        div.innerHTML = `
          <div class='hourly-slider-title'>Hourly Combined Exposure</div>
          <div class='hourly-slider-label' id='hourly-label-${el.id}'>${data.labels[0]}</div>
          <div class='hourly-slider-row'>
            <button type='button' class='hourly-step-button' id='hourly-prev-${el.id}'>&#9664;</button>
            <input id='hourly-slider-${el.id}' type='range' min='0' max='${data.urls.length - 1}' value='0' step='1'>
            <button type='button' class='hourly-step-button' id='hourly-next-${el.id}'>&#9654;</button>
          </div>
        `;
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
        L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(div);
        return div;
      };
      sliderControl.addTo(map);

      var slider = document.getElementById('hourly-slider-' + el.id);
      var label = document.getElementById('hourly-label-' + el.id);
      var prevButton = document.getElementById('hourly-prev-' + el.id);
      var nextButton = document.getElementById('hourly-next-' + el.id);

      function setStep(index) {
        var maxIndex = data.urls.length - 1;
        var newIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxIndex, index));
        if (map.hasLayer(overlays[currentIndex])) map.removeLayer(overlays[currentIndex]);
        overlays[newIndex].addTo(map);
        currentIndex = newIndex;
        slider.value = newIndex;
        label.innerHTML = data.labels[newIndex];
        if (prevButton) prevButton.disabled = newIndex === 0;
        if (nextButton) nextButton.disabled = newIndex === maxIndex;
      }

      slider.addEventListener('input', function(e) { setStep(parseInt(e.target.value)); });
      slider.addEventListener('change', function(e) { setStep(parseInt(e.target.value)); });
      prevButton.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); setStep(parseInt(slider.value) - 1); });
      nextButton.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); setStep(parseInt(slider.value) + 1); });
      setStep(0);
    }
    ",
    data = list(
      urls = hourly_png_data,
      labels = hourly_labels,
      xmin = template_bounds$xmin,
      ymin = template_bounds$ymin,
      xmax = template_bounds$xmax,
      ymax = template_bounds$ymax
    )
  )
```
